title: ハロウィンカラオケパーリィ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After class, Agnes Digital and I grab drinks for a casual meeting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huwhaaatdhjafs?! K-karaoke? W-with you? Me???

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We've got this like free coupon thing, so we're getting a group together for a Halloween karaoke party! Win-dings and Dotsy are coming too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The coupon covers up to six people, so it'd lowkey be a waste going with just five. You can come too if you want, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Oh, sure, if you don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Aaafhdk, I'm actually here with them… Omigosh noooo, I can't believe I'm literally here with them live in person I can't do thiiis!
choice_data_list: (…She says with a massive, doofy smile.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Woo woo woooooo! Lemme get this party rocking with song numero one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Here! Y-your mic, your radiance.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gwahaha! I'm gonna make this LOUD! Hey! Hey! Heyhey!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh! Um, you certainly are bringing the energy! I-I'll try too! Just… How are you supposed to cheer for someone at karaoke? W-woo?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I brought some light sticks with me! Feel free to use them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, Doto's drink is dangerously close to the edge of the table!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let me just scootch it over a bit for her…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks, Digital. You're really looking out for everyone, huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwaa?! That's not—I wasn't… I just happened to notice, and… and!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No worries, I get it. Helios knocks drinks over all the time, so I just kinda naturally keep an eye out now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I feel like you and I have a lot in common. Like we're always watching everyone else, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyah?! Me? A lot? In common with you? I-I don't even know what to say, but I guess I do find you pretty relatable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Yeah… I feel like seeing other people happy makes Palmer happy too…)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hold up! I just realized—Digiridoo hasn't sung anything yet! C'mon girl, don't leave us hanging!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right! I'm so sorry, I didn't notice we'd been hogging the mic. What would you like to sing?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, I couldn't possibly! Don't mind me, I'm just here to listen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Cut out the shy crap and sing something for us! Now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Aaashdgjk, I'm not being shy, per se… It's just—there's plenty of otaku-y songs I can sing, but…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But those would only be fun for me! I don't know any normie songs that everyone would enjoy, so really, I'm fine!
choice_data_list: You're part of "everyone" too, you know. Have some fun!
You're part of "everyone" too, you know. Have some fun!
I'm sure we're all curious what kind of music you like!
I'm sure we're all curious what kind of music you like!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But those would only be fun for me! I don't know any normie songs that everyone would enjoy, so really, I'm fine!
choice_data_list: You're part of "everyone" too, you know. Have some fun!
You're part of "everyone" too, you know. Have some fun!
I'm sure we're all curious what kind of music you like!
I'm sure we're all curious what kind of music you like!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …! You really mean it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Duh! We're friends, right? If you're not having fun, neither are we!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uuuahdjhg… Well, if you put it like that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll guess I'll go ahead and put in a song I love. If that's okay?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: To be honest, though, my favorite thing is seeing all my oshi Umamusume having a blast!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So all I've gotta do is sing something that gets Umas pumped! Something my idols would have fun singing! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay, get ready! Here comes the Umamusume song! The eternal Uma simp anthem!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Umadacchi! ♪ Oooh! Umapyoi! Umapyoi! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Sukidacchi! Oooooh! Umapoi! ♪ Uma uma umya unya—3, 2, 1, fight! ♪

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: WOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (I knew it! There's not an Umamusume alive who doesn't get hyped for Umapyoi! They're all so adorable, cheering along!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone had a great time—Agnes Digital included.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You… you are?! But why would my oshis want to know about me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Although… They may be oshis to me, but to them… I'm another student at their school. A friend.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Whew. I am but a humble simp, but for all of you, I'll steel my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's usually against fangirl code to bombard others with nerd talk, but if you're curious, I'll sing you the song of my people!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh! I feel like I've heard this before. It was a big hit decades ago, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Decades ago?! You mean it's older than I am?! Digital, you weren't even born when this song came out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Allow me to explain during the bridge—you're both right! This song is a classic that's been covered over the years, trending time and time again with new lyrics!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It started out as a song to cheer for a certain Umamusume racer, but one of the band members had a bad habit of being late, so the song evolved into a silly way to hurry him up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Omg this song highkey slaps! The lyrics and beat are so fast! Run, run, Umamusume! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm digging it too! I'm preeetty sure my grandma has a copy of the original record lying around.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh my glob, really?! But it's so rare! That's the Mejiro family for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The song really breaks the ice, and they continue chatting afterwards. The karaoke party ends up being a blast!
